in_sanskrit.name: Mustakin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Firm, Steady
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mustakin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Arabic word ‘mustak’, meaning firm or steadfast. It signifies someone who is strong and determined, and who remains unwavering even in the face of adversity.
